races.name: Dubai International Airport World Trophy Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
STARLUST was best of the home team in the Nunthorpe and confirmed himself as still in good form despite being positioned away from the other principals at the Curragh last week. He can capitalise on the drop in grade at the chief expense of Redorange, who looks well up to making his presence felt in minor Group company. Diligent Harry can complete the 1-2-3.

  1. STARLUST
  2. REDORANGE
  3. DILIGENT HARRY

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Autumn Cup Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
FRENCH DUKE ran subsequent listed winner Plage de Havre to within a nose at the Ebor Festival last month and he can go one place better despite a 5 lb rise. Primo Lara was in the frame behind the selection at York and has since scored at Kempton, so merits plenty of respect, whilst Pearl River is also a player with the step back up in trip likely to suit.

  1. FRENCH DUKE (IRE)
  2. PRIMO LARA (IRE)
  3. PEARL RIVER

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Mill Reef Stakes (Group 2) (In Honour Of Ian Balding)
races.verdict:
The likeable ARAPAHO GOLD can defy a penalty acquired for last month's Gimcrack success and can take his record to 5-5. Jolivette produced an improved effort in the Lowther last time and is also shortlisted alongside Nabati, who ran the selection close at Newbury.

  1. ARAPAHO GOLD (IRE)
  2. JOLIVETTE
  3. NABATI (IRE)

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A competitive heat in which the vote goes to BOYFRIEND, who has held his form well since scoring at Sandown and probably would've resumed winning ways granted more luck at Salisbury earlier in the month. Last weekend's Doncaster winner Almekarem is highly respected from a light weight, with Capall Rasa and Stem also shortlisted.

  1. BOYFRIEND
  2. ALMEKAREM (IRE)
  3. CAPALL RASA (IRE)

races.name: Pump Technology Metro Rod Partnership EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KICKING BEAR'S debut was chock-full of promise and with the promise of plenty more to come, he should take some stopping. As you'd expect for an autumn Newbury maiden there's plenty of depth to this, with Kodiac City promising in his own right, while Iron Stone Lad and Coloniser are perhaps the pick of the newcomers.

  1. KICKING BEAR (FR)
  2. KODIAC CITY (IRE)
  3. IRON STONE LAD

races.name: Conundrum Consulting Handicap
races.verdict:
Winner of 2 of his 3 starts last year, CASTLE ROCK ran to a useful level when second at Newmarket on handicap/seasonal debut in August and he can build on that effort to add to his tally. Heading the list of dangers is Aalto, who has run well both starts since his Bunbury Cup success, with Mr Writer and Anyasi also considered.

  1. CASTLE ROCK
  2. AALTO (FR)
  3. MR WRITER (IRE)

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Finest Surprise Handicap (Str)
races.verdict:
STORMING POINT has made an encouraging start in handicaps, staying on well for fifth in a competitive contest at York last month, so he is fancied to take advantage of this drop in grade. He can see off the challenge of Abundant, who is respected arriving on the back of a C&D success, with Crossbar one to note making handicap debut.

  1. STORMING POINT
  2. ABUNDANT (IRE)
  3. CROSSBAR (IRE)

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Bet 5 Get 30 New Customer Offer' Handicap
races.verdict:
THEORYOFEVERYTHING had an excuse last time and his good C&D record (including second in this last year off 4 lb higher) earns him the vote over Hawksbill (whose stable has won this twice with Revich in recent years) unexposed 3-y-o McMurray and the selection's stablemate Spoken Truth.

  1. THEORYOFEVERYTHING
  2. HAWKSBILL
  3. MCMURRAY (IRE)

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Get Racing Bet Builder Winnings Boosts' Doonside Cup Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
Although ECUREUIL SECRET hasn't been seen for over a year the fact he won on his 3-y-o debut and was most impressive on his 4-y-o reappearance suggests that fresh could be the time to catch him. Ice Max is a class act in this grade on his day and is feared most ahead of High Stock.

  1. ECUREUIL SECRET (FR)
  2. ICE MAX
  3. HIGH STOCK

races.name: Ladbrokes Ayr Silver Cup Handicap
races.verdict:
This is wide open as usual but David O'Meara's soft-ground scorer TOYOTOMI could prove the answer with Oisin Murphy an eye-catching booking after his luckless run in a big-field handicap at the Curragh last time. Rapper's Delight is better than his recent form figures suggest and can go well off a handy-looking mark, while Desert Falcon, Deep Havana and Trilby all have plenty to recommend them too in a cracking renewal of the Silver Cup.

  1. TOYOTOMI (FR)
  2. RAPPER'S DELIGHT
  3. DESERT FALCON (IRE)

races.name: Ladbrokes 'New Customers Get 50/1 Old Firm Offer' Firth Of Clyde (Fillies' Group 3)
races.verdict:
SILENT BEAUTY banished the memory of her Albany flop with an impressive listed success at Ripon 19 days ago and can make her mark at Group level now. Dark Issue was only narrowly denied in Group 3 company at Salisbury last time and can be competitive, while Ruby Moon could run a big race if coping with the ground.

  1. SILENT BEAUTY (IRE)
  2. DARK ISSUE (IRE)
  3. RUBY MOON (IRE)

races.name: Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict:
With conditions in his favour for the first time in a while, a bigger performance is expected from BINHAREER, and he's taken to land this valuable pot. Far Above Dream and Dance In The Storm bring strong York form to the table and are feared most. Ardisia and Twilight Calls are others to note in a typically stacked renewal, along with last year's winner Run Boy Run.

  1. BINHAREER (IRE)
  2. FAR ABOVE DREAM (IRE)
  3. DANCE IN THE STORM

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A valuable novice in which the vote goes to newcomer GOLDEN SOUK, who ticks plenty of boxes on paper for a quality yard. Gold Key and Amir Lehbab have made promising starts to their careers and can put their experience to good use, while expensive breeze-up purchase Tyrrhenian Thunder is another debutant to note.

  1. GOLDEN SOUK (IRE)
  2. GOLD KEY (IRE)
  3. AMIR LEHBAB (FR)

races.name: Jordan Electrics Handicap
races.verdict:
A competitive 7f handicap to conclude the card. JANNAS JOURNEY quickly cast aside a lesser effort when a close third at Hamilton last month and remains on a workable mark on the pick of last season's efforts, so she earns the tentative vote. Blakefell and Quest For Fun head the dangers in that order.

  1. JANNAS JOURNEY (IRE)
  2. BLAKEFELL (IRE)
  3. QUEST FOR FUN

races.name: Turners British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The market should prove highly revealing but Charlie Appleby has an excellent recent record in this and his Dubawi filly FLOWER SHOW is taken to build on a promising debut third at Sandown and come out on top. Both Zhuri and Gainful are in excellent hands and make plenty of appeal on paper so need considering, especially if the betting speaks in their favour.

  1. FLOWER SHOW (IRE)
  2. ZHURI
  3. GAINFUL

races.name: Turners Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
A few of these fillies have a bit to prove here so this looks a good opportunity for STORMY MUSIC to quickly resume winning ways on the back of an unlucky-in-running third on the July course here last time out. Karl Burke's handicap debutante Prosperity remains quite unexposed and rates the main threat ahead of Food For Thought and Thaluna.

  1. STORMY MUSIC
  2. PROSPERITY
  3. FOOD FOR THOUGHT

races.name: Turners Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks wide open but ROGUE ALLEGIANCE has made a bright start to life under the expert tutelage of James Owen and can make light of a 3 lb rise to complete a hat-trick. C&D scorer Cherry Cobbler is feared most on the back of a very good second on the July course here, while Raggaas, Golden Strike and Kiniro can also play a prominent role.

  1. ROGUE ALLEGIANCE (IRE)
  2. CHERRY COBBLER
  3. RAGGAAS

races.name: Turners Parks Group Ltd Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
A few with chances but RAJAKING can race off the same mark as when an excellent recent third on the July course here so edges the vote from progressive 3-y-o Explosive Finish and bang-in-form Fifty Nifty.

  1. RAJAKING
  2. EXPLOSIVE FINNISH
  3. FIFTY NIFTY (IRE)

races.name: Turners Parks Group Ltd Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
OLD IS GOLD has been rejuvenated by the fitting of a visor and can make light of a 5 lb weights rise and follow up his all-the-way Goodwood success. Waistcoat didn't enjoy the rub of the green at Windsor last time and can emerge as the main danger ahead of Sierra Sands and Quantum Power.

  1. OLD IS GOLD (IRE)
  2. WAISTCOAT
  3. SIERRA SANDS (IRE)

races.name: Turners Cesarewitch Trial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
IN THE BREEZE pulled clear of the rest when runner-up at Haydock last time and, off just a 1 lb higher mark, is fancied to bag a third victory of the season with this longer trip also a likely positive. Gooloogong has been hit hard by the official assessor for his wide-margin Goodwood success but could still emerge as the chief threat ahead of Appier and Percy Shelley.

  1. IN THE BREEZE (IRE)
  2. GOOLOOGONG (IRE)
  3. APPIER (IRE)

races.name: Turners Of Soham Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
HUMPHREY hasn't looked altogether straightforward when a beaten favourite on both of his starts, but his form is strong and the 7 lb he receives from debut-winner Amazonica may prove decisive. Sir Hannibal also brings solid novice form to the table but he's been off the track for over 13 months.

  1. HUMPHREY
  2. AMAZONICA (IRE)
  3. SIR HANNIBAL (GER)

races.name: Turners Amateur Jockeys' Cambridgeshire Handicap
races.verdict:
RAPIDE VEGA has made a bright start for his new yard so tops the shortlist having been edged out by only a fellow 3-y-o at Beverley 3 weeks ago. Zatsgood has been running well in slightly better company so is next best ahead of Drifts Away, who is 2 from 2 in headgear.

  1. RAPIDE VEGA (IRE)
  2. ZATSGOOD
  3. DRIFTS AWAY

races.name: quinnbet.com Handicap
races.verdict:
TYPEFACE is lurking on handy mark back on the all-weather and he gets the vote. The dangers are headed by Gemini Man, who chased home a subsequent winner here last time. New Objective, Pride Eye and Parole Officer also need considering in a competitive opener.

  1. TYPEFACE
  2. GEMINI MAN (IRE)
  3. NEW OBJECTIVE

races.name: QuinnBet Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
races.verdict:
TEN SIXTY SIX looks the percentage call following her near miss at Ripon. Raise The Stakes, Wyvill and Fairydale also merit consideration on the back of creditable placed efforts last time.

  1. TEN SIXTY SIX (IRE)
  2. FAIRYDALE (IRE)
  3. RAISE THE STAKES (IRE)

races.name: QuinnBet Extra Place EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Cheveley Park home-bred filly JAHAMI is in good hands and may be able to make a winning start. Enriched sets the standard of those with experience.

  1. JAHAMI
  2. ENRICHED
  3. BAHIA BONITA

races.name: Eric Hussain 58th Birthday Celebration Race Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GROW OLD WITH ME has clearly had issues but arguably has the strongest form on offer. He's narrowly preferred to Weffagg, who was turned over at a short price when last seen.

  1. GROW OLD WITH ME (IRE)
  2. WEFFAAG
  3. DIVINE SYMMETRY

races.name: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
races.verdict:
BONNIE'S BOY shaped as if still in good form when fifth at York last time, nearest at the finish having been left poorly placed, so he could be ready to get back to winning ways returned to this venue. He gets the vote ahead of the in-form Style King, with Hundred Caps also considered.

  1. BONNIE'S BOY
  2. STYLE KING (IRE)
  3. HUNDRED CAPS

races.name: Happy Birthday Dave Miller From Probio energy.com Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
DONALD confirmed his return to form when opening his account at Carlisle 10 days ago and, with a bit more scope to improve than the rest, he looks up to defying a 2 lb higher mark. Operation Gimcrack and Tickets head the opposition.

  1. DONALD
  2. OPERATION GIMCRACK (IRE)
  3. TICKETS

races.name: Happy Birthday Dave Miller From Probio energy.com Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
GET UP EVERYBODY confirmed his recent promise when off the mark over C&D last month and, with that form proving solid, a 3 lb rise doesn't look enough to prevent the follow up. Melissa Honey and Beach Partee also arrive in form and must be respected.

  1. GET UP EVERYBODY (IRE)
  2. MELISSA HONEY
  3. BEACH PARTEE

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
TAWAAZON has yet to win this season, but he’s been shaping up reasonably well lately and is taken to capitalise on his much-reduced mark. Last-time-out scorers Ellie's de Vega and Solid Bond are feared most in that order.

  1. TAWAAZON (IRE)
  2. ELLIE'S DE VEGA
  3. SOLID BOND (IRE)

races.name: Get The Inside Track With raceday-ready.com Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
BARLEYBROWN hasn't always looked the heartiest, but he meets Walk On Walk On on slightly better terms than when runner-up to that rival over C&D 17 days ago, so he's taken to reverse the form and come out on top. Volenti, Falcon Nine and Tees George are a trio of others to consider.

  1. BARLEYBROWN
  2. VOLENTI (IRE)
  3. FALCON NINE

races.name: Vault Money EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
IMPULSIVE SPIRIT found the Dick Poole too much on second start but she created a favourable impression when winning on debut and looks up to defying a penalty back down in class. Havana Flash also eases back in grade and is feared most, ahead of Rhodes Runner.

  1. IMPULSIVE SPIRIT (IRE)
  2. HAVANA FLASH (IRE)
  3. RHODES RUNNER (IRE)

races.name: John Smith's Nursery
races.verdict:
GERRY'S DARLING has one of the most solid profiles on show and looks sure to give her running having coped with some good to soft ground last time and the fact she's well drawn is another boost. Somers Isles is by far the least exposed and is respected for top stable from stall 2, while Absolute Diamond also has some factors in her favour so could bounce back from a tame effort.

  1. GERRY'S DARLING
  2. SOMERS ISLES (IRE)
  3. ABSOLUTE DIAMOND (IRE)

races.name: Destination2 Selling Stakes
races.verdict:
DUNKELD DREAMER is a reliable sort and these terms look favourable enough for her to make a big impact against older rivals, with her draw and run style also ideal. Course winner Patagonia Girl and the progressive Reds And Wolves are feared most.

  1. DUNKELD DREAMER (IRE)
  2. PATAGONIA GIRL
  3. REDS AND WOLVES (IRE)

races.name: Kidsbank Chester Handicap
races.verdict:
KIRKDALE carried on where he'd left off earlier in the year when returning from 5 months off with an excellent second, and if he can transfer that progress back to turf then he could resume winning ways at the expense of Havana Rum, who is well treated now and will appreciate the return to 6f, while Supreme King could take a hand.

  1. KIRKDALE (IRE)
  2. HAVANA RUM (IRE)
  3. SUPREME KING (IRE)

races.name: Halliwell Jones Handicap
races.verdict:
The speed that SUDDEN FLIGHT showed last time suggests this drop back to 5f may suit. He'll be fine whatever the ground is and has a handy draw, so there are reasons to be hopeful. Over Spiced has been a model of consistency lately and is the second choice ahead of Copper Knight and the Paul Midgley pair Elegant Erin and Vingegaard.

  1. SUDDEN FLIGHT
  2. OVER SPICED
  3. COPPER KNIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Style Joinery Handicap
races.verdict:
KING OF THUNDER looked better than ever when winning over C&D under similar conditions last week and he's taken to follow up. First Time and Merry are feared most.

  1. KING OF THUNDER
  2. FIRST TIME (IRE)
  3. MERRY

races.name: Lord Mayor's Spooktacular Fireworks Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
MELON presumably has good handicap hurdles as his main aim in the coming months, but it's worth taking a chance that he's tuned up enough to take advantage of what should be a good mark in this sphere. The thriving Zimmerman is the second choice ahead of Spartan Times.

  1. MELON (GER)
  2. ZIMMERMAN
  3. SPARTAN TIMES

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Download Our App' Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
DALLAS STAR is a very classy recruit to hurdling given his Flat ability and having joined an excellent yard, he can provide Amo Racing with a debut winner over obstacles. En Or and Ivatt may offer most resistance.

  1. DALLAS STAR (FR)
  2. EN OR (FR)
  3. IVATT

races.name: SIS, Supporting Irish Racing Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
HOPEFUL HERO confirmed he's in top form when runner-up at Kilbeggan 2 weeks ago and while he has a 3 lb rise to deal with, he may well be up to the job. Del Boys Diva shaped very well at that track herself last time, finding 19f too much of a test so she's second choice, with Littlefoot dangerous from this lower hurdles mark.

  1. HOPEFUL HERO (IRE)
  2. DEL BOYS DIVA (IRE)
  3. LITTLEFOOT (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Casino 'Slot Games & Live Casino' Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
ANY CHANCE wasn't seen to best effect when eighth in a big-field Limerick handicap last time and can get off the mark back in maiden company. Mr Devlin is feared most in his bid to get off the mark at the eighth attempt ahead of Market Square who can take a step forward from his hurdling debut seventh at Killarney.

  1. ANY CHANCE (IRE)
  2. MR DEVLIN (IRE)
  3. MARKET SQUARE (IRE)

races.name: Millbrook Food Group 100 Years Celebration Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
In a wide-open handicap, it could be worth chancing TOMAS O MAILLE from his much-reduced mark. Maxicourt, Classy CC, Hatfield Hammer and Scary Askari also appeal, with Annie Button interesting if lining up.

  1. TOMAS O MAILLE (IRE)
  2. MAXICOURT (IRE)
  3. CLASSY CC (IRE)

races.name: Millbrook Food Group 100 Years Celebration Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
GOIN' looks poised to strike on the back of an improved effort at Bellewstown last month. Backinabit is feared most if allowed the run of the race. Mother Ship, No Big Deal, Clanokre Lass and Jurality also need considering in a wide-open handicap.

  1. GOIN'
  2. BACKINABIT (IRE)
  3. NO BIG DEAL (IRE)

races.name: Meath Farm Machinery Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Bumper winner MOSSY WAY showed promise in a couple of maiden hurdles last season, particularly at Fairyhouse in a race which has worked out well, and is taken to make it third time lucky over timber. Emerald Enigma is the obvious danger, with today's longer trip likely to suit her. Airds Moss made a fairly encouraging start to his hurdle career at Killarney and completes the shortlist.

  1. MOSSY WAY (IRE)
  2. EMERALD ENIGMA (IRE)
  3. AIRDS MOSS (IRE)

races.name: Start Your Racing TV Free Trial Now Ladies Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TOOR KHOV was in good form when last seen in the spring and could be the answer if ready to pick up where he left off. Sallap hasn't been seen to best effect on either of her last 2 outings and leaves the impression she's still ahead of her mark. Knocknagoran Lady is thriving at present and completes the shortlist.

  1. TOOR KHOV (IRE)
  2. SALLAP (IRE)
  3. KNOCKNAGORAN LADY (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Best Odds Guaranteed Overnight' Flat Race
races.verdict:
EL PARAISO makes plenty of appeal on paper for a yard going well with its bumper horses (last 3 all successful), so he gets the nod to continue that good run before market clues. Ellen Imlach is another appealing newcomer who warrants close scrutiny in the betting, while the form of Rocky Alfonso's debut has worked out reasonably well and he's the narrow pick of those with experience, ahead of Walkwithmyfriend, who is turned out relatively quickly following a demanding race at Kilbeggan.

  1. EL PARAISO
  2. ELLEN IMLACH (FR)
  3. ROCKY ALFONSO (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again October 2nd & 3rd Race
races.verdict:
GREYDREAMBELIEVER has found one too good at this track 3 times this year, but the conditions of this race should suit so she can gain her revenge on Rion Rubette. City House is in good heart and also respected.

  1. GREYDREAMBELIEVER (IRE)
  2. RION RUBETTE
  3. CITY HOUSE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
NEVERMINDTHERAIN ran well when third in a Group 3 at Leopardstown in July and, with her Cork run best ignored and this step up to 1m likely to suit, she is taken to open her account. Isle of Capri improved when third at Leopardstown last month and rates the main threat if building on that, while the well-bred newcomer Hereafter, a half-sister to smart winners from a quality family, is respected on debut.

  1. NEVERMINDTHERAIN (IRE)
  2. ISLE OF CAPRI (IRE)
  3. HEREAFTER (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict:
ALBANY COUNTY shaped with encouragement when second at the Curragh 21 days ago and is taken to go one better with improvement expected. Mount Meru, related to high-class Logician and out of a 2-y-o 1m winner, represents a top yard and could prove the main threat, while the well-bred Pirate of Penzance can make an impact if fully tuned up on debut.

  1. ALBANY COUNTY (IRE)
  2. MOUNT MERU
  3. PIRATE OF PENZANCE (IRE)

races.name: Denny Cordell Lavarack & Lanwades Stud Fillies Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Group 3)
races.verdict:
FAIYUM won this by 7 lengths last year and will take plenty of beating if building on her second in a similar event at the Curragh 3 weeks ago. Star Performer impressed over C&D last time and rates the main danger, with further progress expected, while Sindria goes well here and can also be involved at her best.

  1. FAIYUM
  2. STAR PERFORMER (IRE)
  3. SINDRIA (IRE)

races.name: SIS Maiden
races.verdict:
If SHEREKIYA gets back to the form she showed when third in a Curragh handicap on her penultimate start she might prove the answer to this maiden. Ryefield Dasher has acquitted himself well in handicaps lately and is second choice ahead of Joseph O'Brien's Big Cypress. Colpe Cross could also play a prominent role if recapturing last year's form with her reappearance behind her.

  1. SHEREKIYA (IRE)
  2. RYEFIELD DASHER (IRE)
  3. BIG CYPRESS

races.name: Support The Irish Injured Jockeys Fund Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
ROAMING COYOTE is worth another chance to confirm his handicap-debut promise over C&D when beaten only by a useful sort. This does look competitive, though, with Make The Tide and Navajo Point heading the dangers.

  1. ROAMING COYOTE (IRE)
  2. MAKE THE TIDE (IRE)
  3. NAVAJO POINT (IRE)

races.name: BOYLE Sports Home Of Early Payout Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
Competitive stuff with REAL PETITE the tentative selection back on her winning mark. The dangers are headed by Reponse Finale, who has thrived for her current yard, and lightly-raced 3-y-o Haroussa, who has the profile to do much better.

  1. REAL PETITE (GER)
  2. REPONSE FINALE (IRE)
  3. HAROUSSA (IRE)
